# Prototype spaced repetition

Initial state: interval 0, ease 2.30, mastery 0, stage unseen. First-attempt independent success schedules 7 days; correct after hint 1 schedules up to 5 days; correct after hint 2 or the final guided step schedules 1–2 days; failure schedules 1 day. Correct guesses are treated as weak evidence and scheduled for 1 day.
